features.name: Energy Consumption Tracking
features.description: New capability to track energy consumption in kilowatt hours from sustainability journal or purchase documents. Users can enter values based on actual consumption or use default values for energy sources.
caveats: Energy source values can be set as defaults at sustainability account subcategory level, not account level

features.name: Energy Source Selection
features.description: Allows users to choose energy source information including nuclear, solar, wind, power, coal or other sources. Can be configured to require energy value entry or set as optional.
caveats: Must be configured at sustainability account subcategory level

features.name: Energy Value Required Field
features.description: Boolean field that can be set at sustainability account subcategory level to enforce mandatory energy value entry before posting documents.
caveats: Can be overridden if renewable energy field is also true

features.name: On-Site Energy Generation Tracking
features.description: Field to specify whether energy source generation is on-site or not. Existing field in the system that can now be used in energy tracking workflows.
caveats: This is not a new field, it was already in the system

features.name: Renewable Energy Field
features.description: Boolean field to mark whether energy is from renewable sources. Can override energy value requirements when set to true.
caveats: Field existed from early beginning of sustainability module

features.name: Energy Posting Without Emissions
features.description: Allows posting energy consumption data even when emission values are not yet entered, enabling separate workflows for energy and emissions tracking.
caveats: Only possible if energy value was previously entered
